en: Sepia-toned interior view of a very long, formal dining hall with rows of neatly set tables and wooden chairs. The room has high decorated ceilings, hanging lamps, tall windows on the right, and framed pictures and a crucifix on the far wall, indicating a Catholic institution. Text printed at the bottom reads the name and location of the college and identifies the room as the dining hall.
